Greetings, Agents.


This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.


A being who has existed in countless forms across the ages 
has returned to MARVEL Future Fight with a brand-new look!

 

Kang the Conqueror, driven by his ambition 
to raise an army in the Quantum Realm and seize control of every dimension, 
has received a New Uniform and Tier-4 Advancement.

Agents, please download the 1/6 (Tue) patch 
to check out his new skills and enhanced power!


■ 1/6 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 1/7 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 1/6 (Tue) 19:00 (PST)

 

[1/7 (Wed) 2:31 (UTC+0), 1/6 (Tue) 18:31 (PST) added]
The patch has been completed as of 1/7 (Wed) 2:30 (UTC+0), 1/6 (Tue) 18:30 (PST).
Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
Completion time will be announced once the patch has been completed.
* The patch will be applied in waves, and the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 


▣ One New Uniform

 

One new Uniform, Kang the Conqueror <Rama-Tut>, has been added.
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The new Uniform will be on sale for 40% off during the <Kang the Conqueror Update Celebration Event>  and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

▣ Kang the Conqueror Tier-4

 

Kang the Conqueror is now available for Tier-4 Advancement. 
To conquer countless timelines with ease, he has calculated that this immense power is a necessary part of his grand design.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 


We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
